verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical and share the same flaws. The headline sits right against the left edge (about 6px in) while the CTA is inset about 16px, so they don't line up. The OBSIDIAN logo sits under the headline instead of leading as it did in the original. The three elements float with no grid, and about 110px at the top is empty. A also leaves about 110px empty below the CTA. B places the CTA lower, which fills the height a little better, but it widens the gap between headline and logo to about 190px, so the elements still look scattered rather than grouped.
